venue_notes: DATE UNCONFIRMED: the brief says Saturday 12 September 2026, but today is 13 October 2026 so that date has passed. All bookings are provisional until the client confirms the correct date.
No vendor quotes received yet; budget total_eur is 0 as a placeholder. Hard cap EUR 42,000 all in, so get itemised quotes including VAT and service, and keep a 5-8% contingency.
Interpreter and her microphone are protected from cuts. Fireworks are cut first.

Strictly no nuts anywhere, including almonds in the cake. Eero's nephew carries an EpiPen. Get written confirmation on cross-contamination, vegetarian substitutes (pesto, nut cheeses) and bar items (amaretto, orgeat). Confirm the 11 vegetarian and 4 children's meals are included in the 96 guests.
Pimienta the dog is the ring bearer: tell the quinta now, check pet policy for the chapel, olive grove and cellar, arrange a handler and a resting place, and keep the dog away from the kitchen.

If the forecast is above 32C, move cocktails to the wine cellar. Suggested decision 48 hours before. Ask the quinta about cellar capacity for 96, ventilation and bar layout, and pre-plan with caterer and DJ.
If the ceremony starts late, shorten the cocktails, never the ceremony. Brief caterer and photographer.

Proposed logistics: venue access 12:00-14:30 with sound check, guest shuttles about 15:00-15:20, staggered return shuttles (e.g. 23:00, 00:15, 01:30) for 96 guests using two 50-seat coaches or three minibuses. Confirm hotel distance and a dispatcher contact.
DJ: no Macarena, confirmed in writing.

Open client questions: correct date; budget breakdown and already-booked vendors; hotel name and distance; number of Eero's family confirmed (Finnish menu cards if more than 25); interpreter format (simultaneous or consecutive) and Aino-Kaarina's hearing aid system; dog handler; forecast source and cut-off; whether Aino-Kaarina also sits at the head table; preferred alternative photographer.
